info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 1 hour final exam + 104 hours self-study
info.description:
This course is designed to provide a systematic introduction to listening-comprehension and note-taking skills.

Upon completion of the course, students should be able to:

LO1. *Evaluate listening comprehension and note-taking skills.

LO2. *Compare the key differences between the language of lecturing and the language of writing; *notice the lecture structure and cues; *understand the role of paraphrase, repetition, exemplification and digression; *use context and prediction to get main ideas; *predict content and lecture direction.

LO3. *Understand lecture focus and direction from introductions; *use conclusions to check the lecture’s main points; *understand and avoid digressions.

LO4. *Recognize and use key words; *make use of abbreviations; *use note-taking symbols and abbreviations effectively; *visually represent relationships and the relative importance of information.

LO5. *Take notes on numbers and statistics effectively.

LO6. *Understand the importance of recognizing lecture organization; *recognize organizational plans within lectures; *define terms through simple and extended definitions; *list subtopics; *exemplify a topic.

LO7. *Describe characteristics of a lecture; *describe a process or sequence of events; *classify subtopics.

LO8. *Describe a causal relationship; *compare and contrast information; *recognize generalizations and their support.

Assessment structure:

1) On-going assessment

- Progress Tests 03*15%=45%

- Assignment 15%

2) Final Examination (FE) 40%

3) Final Result 100%

4) Completion Criteria:

On-going assessment >0, Final Exam Score >=4/10 & Final Result >=5/10

- If FE < 4/10, student must resit exam;
info.studentTasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfil tasks given by teacher after class

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
info.tools:
- Internet

- foxit reader for PDF files
